meta.name: golden-chat-single
meta.description: Use when testing the golden_chat_single golden build

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要验证黄金构建的聊天功能
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify the golden chat build

howto.what: 装了这个技能,Claude 可以查阅一个 Slack 频道(#general)里的 1 条聊天记录,从中找出团队讨论的解决方案、代码片段、决策、排障步骤或共享链接等信息。
howto.when: 当用户要求测试 golden_chat_single golden build,或需要查找该聊天记录中的解决方案、代码片段、团队决策等内容时触发。

say.text: 测试 golden_chat_single 构建,读一下聊天记录。
say.note: Claude 会调用该技能查看记录。

say.text: 这个 Slack 对话里有什么解决方案?
say.note: Claude 会从记录中提取方案。

say.text: 告诉我这段聊天中的团队决策。
say.note: Claude 会尝试从单条消息中找决策信息。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude read a 1-message Slack chat history (channel #general) from the golden_chat_single build and find discussed solutions, code snippets, decisions, troubleshooting steps, or shared links.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to test the golden_chat_single golden build, or needs to look up solutions, code snippets, team decisions, etc. from this chat history.

say_en.text: Test the golden_chat_single build and read the chat log.
say_en.note: Claude will invoke the skill to view the record.

say_en.text: What solutions are in this Slack conversation?
say_en.note: Claude will extract solutions from the record.

say_en.text: Tell me the team decisions in this chat.
say_en.note: Claude will try to find decision info in the single message.
